name: gitleaks:scan

options.description: Write report without failing when findings are detected.

summary: Scan a project path for hardcoded secrets with Gitleaks.
help: Scans the selected project path inside the development container. The default path is the project root. Writes a JSON report to .docker-dev/reports/gitleaks.json and exits with a non-zero status when Gitleaks finds leaks.
